name: discoverIE Group plc
summary: discoverIE Group plc designs, manufactures, and supplies specialist electronic components for industrial applications in the United Kingdom, Europe, North America, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Magnetics & Controls; and Sensing & Connectivity segments. The company offers magnetic and power components, embedded computing and interface controls, and sensing and connectivity components for industrial applications. The Magnetics & Controls segment offers Electronics for power conversion and switching, X-ray detection, signal conditioning, monitoring, human-machine interface controls and embedded computing.
